createteleporters.ponder.c_portal_1.text:
The Custom Portal Controller is the heart of your teleportation system.
Place it in the bottom row, leaving one free block on each side.
Placing it automatically adds the two side blocks.

Set both controllers to Portal to Portal mode.
Right-click each controller with the same Advanced TP Link
to pair them.
createteleporters.ponder.c_portal_2.text:
Portal frames must be built in a valid square or rectangular shape.
The opening can be 3 to 21 blocks wide and 3 to 21 blocks tall.
Use Quantum Casings and place the base anywhere along the bottom,
with room for a dummy block on each side.

Ensure the interior of the frame is empty of blocks and fluids.
The portal will fill this space automatically
when activated. Keep the entire frame, including its corners, intact.
createteleporters.ponder.c_portal_3.text:
Pump at least 256 mB of Telejuice into each portal base.
Place one Advanced TP Link in either portal: one supplies the pair.
Both frames must be valid for the pair to activate.

To link two portals together:
1. Set both controllers to Portal to Portal mode
2. Right-click both with the same Advanced TP Link
3. Insert one link in either portal and fuel both bases

Normal travel consumes Telejuice at the departure portal.

createteleporters.ponder.c_portal_3.text: The portal activates automatically when both frames, fuel and the link are ready.
createteleporters.ponder.c_portal_coordi: Open the controller and select Coordinates mode to travel to a saved location without a second portal.
At your destination, aim at a loaded block and right-click with an Advanced TP Link to save its position and dimension. Choose a safe arrival spot.
Insert the saved link into the controller's slot and supply at least 256 mB of Telejuice. Step through to reach the saved destination; travel consumes fuel here.
createteleporters.ponder.entity_teleport: Entity Teleporters send players and mobs to a saved location. The full, slab and quarter-height versions use the same setup.
Aim at a loaded block at your destination and right-click with a regular TP Link to save the arrival position. Leave room above it for safe arrival.
Open the teleporter and insert the saved TP Link into its slot. No receiving teleporter is required.
Keep the destination in the same dimension and within the configured Entity Teleporter range. Check the distance status in the teleporter screen.
Fueling and Using an Entity Teleporter
With a saved TP Link inserted, pump Telejuice into the teleporter. Each activation needs and consumes 250 mB.
Stand on the teleporter, or guide a mob onto it, and wait for it to charge. Dropped items do not start charging.
When charging completes, nearby entities arrive at the saved location. Keep the teleporter supplied with Telejuice for the next trip.
